entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 65205373152172032: position at J2016.0. Distance: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 17608: distance 116.55 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.043), at which the luminosity and radius hold (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433): 116.55 +/- 5.012 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 7.0670 +/- 0.2862 mas (same row, RUWE 2.33), 24.7 standard errors, is not used. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): 13.075, -48.404 mas/yr. Radial velocity from SIMBAD's radial velocity for Gaia DR3 65205373152172032 (quality E), from 1953GCRV..C......0W; Gaia DR3 measures none.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 7.747 solar radii from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 17608: radius 7.747 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 211.434 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.783) and temperature (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433). No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 7913 +/- 3358 K from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 17608: effective temperature 7913 +/- 3358 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.448).

entries.subject: Color
entries.finding: Kharitonov, Tereshchenko & Knyazeva (1988), Spectrophotometric Catalogue of Stars (Alma-Ata), record 215: HR 1156; VizieR III/202, through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #b1c6ff. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: HD 23480 is not in the library; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: HR 1156 is not in the catalogue; kiehling: HR 1156 is not among its 60 stars; burnashev: BS 1156 is not in part2; kharitonov: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 7,913 K and log g 2.92 (u1 0.371, u2 0.289): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used. Gravity: log g 2.92 from 2001A&A...378..861C; the 2 published values span log g 2.92 to 4, across which the limb law changes by at most 2.6% of the centre brightness.
